Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner imposed an unnecessary and incorrect constraint by insisting on strict exact-title matching for “The Time to Love” (excluding “Time to Love”), which led to repetitive, unproductive searches and stalled progress. This overcomplication ignored that the task only required comparing earliest releases, where both Amélie (2001) and Time to Love (1927/1965) clearly precede Beginners (2010/2011). The fixation on the definite article and failure to adapt or gather the straightforward Beginners date caused the process to derail.
